name: Plagiophthalmosuchus
sum: Small marine teleosauroid from the Early Jurassic, named in 2020 for a species long placed in Steneosaurus.
holotype: Not stated in the Wikipedia article consulted; check the original description.
material: The type species was named Teleosaurus gracilirostris in 1836 and moved to Steneosaurus in 1961.
biology: A small marine predator that fed on fish, judging from its skull features.
author: Johnson et al. 2020

images.caption: Fossil specimen
